races.paceDynamic: Signora is the only confirmed front runner and will set an uncontested lead from the outset. With no other pace pressers identified, she'll dictate terms throughout at her own rhythm on ground that suits her. The large field of hold-up horses including Ridersinthesky, Expert Dancer, and Lamberella will be bunched behind, creating traffic problems in the straight. This race shape heavily favours the lone pace-setter Signora, as she faces no early pressure and can control the tempo completely.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Signora Leads All
scenarios.trigger: If Signora breaks cleanly and establishes her lead without interference.
scenarios.body: She controls every call under no pressure while the hold-up brigade gets shuffled back and encounters traffic problems when trying to close. Her tactical advantage combined with suitable going makes her very hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and Signora weakens in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get clear runs and superior class tells with Ridersinthesky's proven form edge showing. Expert Dancer and others benefit from the strong pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Signora goes too fast early trying to kill off the field.
scenarios.body: Rayzera and White Lily in the prominent positions avoid the early pace but escape the traffic problems affecting the hold-up horses. They get first run on the weakening leader and hold off the late closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and an unconsidered runner gets a dream run through.
scenarios.body: The form horses underperform and a lightly-raced sort like Glasarmi or Moon Aura finds significant improvement with clear sailing. Trainer Harrington's double-handed approach with different running styles pays off.

races.paceDynamic: Spacebound will lead from the gates with no genuine early pace pressure from this largely hold-up heavy field. With Queen Lioness, El Rehaiby, Treasure Rose and Mystic Bella the only other prominent runners, Spacebound can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will be steady rather than searching, setting up a sprint finish where positioning and turn of foot matter most. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can produce their best work in the final two furlongs when the race comes alive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Spacebound maintains comfortable fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to save energy for a sustained drive, while hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the change of pace. Spacebound's proven front-running ability and fitness edge become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace sets up a cavalry charge in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses with tactical speed get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks from off the pace. The race becomes a pure test of who has the most natural ability and turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly and times their move to perfection
scenarios.body: A horse like Treasure Rose or El Rehaiby gets the ideal trip stalking Spacebound before striking at the optimal moment. Their race fitness and tactical positioning prove superior to the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Spacebound goes too slowly and gets swamped by everything
scenarios.body: The fractions become so pedestrian that even the most one-paced runners can get competitive in a blanket finish. Form and ratings become less relevant when it turns into a sprint from the furlong pole.

races.paceDynamic: Smithfield will likely lead from the gate with minimal early pressure, as most rivals prefer hold-up tactics and the prominent runners like Faoladh and Minaun View typically settle behind the pace. The soft ground will make it harder for the large hold-up contingent to quicken from the back, while several key hold-up horses carry warnings about fading in the finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and the lone leader, as they'll face less traffic and get first run on ground that penalises late closers.

races.paceDynamic: Expound and Walhaan will contest the early lead in this 19-runner field, with Expound likely to take them along at a solid gallop given his front-running tendencies and useful form over trips. The prominent runners Collecting Coin, Fast Tara, Hellorhighwater and Great Mover will track the leaders closely, creating a competitive middle section. This honest early pace combined with the large field and yielding ground strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish fastest.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Crinshawn is the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field and will likely set an uncontested lead over 1m4f, creating a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The majority of runners are hold-up horses including Khormor Syd, Calamint, and Church Mountain, meaning the pace will be modest through the early stages. With such a large field of late runners, the race will develop into a sprint finish where those getting first run and avoiding traffic will have crucial advantages. This setup clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable congestion behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Crinshawn gets an easy lead and stays the trip
scenarios.body: She faces no early pressure and can dictate fractions, then has enough in reserve to hold off late challengers who get caught in traffic. The combination of solo leadership and a big field shuffling behind creates ideal conditions for wire-to-wire success.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow for the leader to sustain
scenarios.body: Hosanna Power or Captain Hanley can track the modest gallop and have enough tactical speed to pounce when Miss Crinshaw weakens in the final furlong. Their prominent style allows them to avoid the worst of the traffic while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Navigation
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates a true staying test
scenarios.body: Khormor Syd or Calamint can weave through the large field and use their finishing kick when others have gone too hard too early. The yielding ground suits their patient style and they benefit from the strong pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If there are multiple fallers or severe interference in the straight
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse with luck in running like Church Mountain or Jurality can benefit from others' misfortunes and sneak through for an unlikely victory. The large field and soft ground increases chances of incidents that reshape the finish.

watchPoints.text: Miss Crinshawn must handle the step up to 1m4f as her only win came over shorter distances
Traffic problems will be severe in the straight with 18 hold-up horses needing room at once
Watch for Khormor Syd getting a clear run as Heffernan is excellent at finding gaps in big fields
Several horses including Patrick Street and Kilgharrahs Love have recent fading tendencies in similar finishes
The yielding ground favors patient types like Calamint who have won on similar conditions recently
